title: La Poem 2026 Countdown Show Finale: Hope & Inspiration
text:
La Poem Ushers in 2026 with Hopeful Performance at Seoul Countdown Show
A captivating performance by the crossover group La Poem marked the arrival of 2026, delivering a message of hope and inspiration to audiences in Seoul and beyond. The group’s appearance at the ‘2026 Countdown Show – Light Now’ has been hailed as a standout moment, setting a positive tone for the year ahead.
La Poem took the stage at 11 PM on December 31st, 2025, at the electronic display board of the main branch of Shinsegae Department Store in Jung-gu, Seoul, to enthusiastic cheers from the crowd. The group delivered passionate renditions of their songs “Sunshine” and “Eres Tú,” blending classical and popular music to create a unique and powerful sound.
A Message of Hope with “Sunshine”
The performance began with “Sunshine,” a song specifically crafted to convey a message of hope. According to reports, the lyrics encourage listeners to “move towards the light again even in difficult moments,” resonating deeply with those welcoming the new year. The song’s dramatic build and emotional intensity were met with an enthusiastic response, powerfully signaling the start of 2026.
Grand Finale with “Eres Tú”
La Poem then performed “Eres Tu” accompanied by a 20-member choir, elevating the performance to new heights. The combination of La Poem’s vocals and the choir’s harmonious blend created a rich and emotive soundscape that captivated both those in attendance and viewers watching the broadcast. One observer noted the performance transcended a typical countdown show, offering genuine comfort and optimism.
La Poem intends to continue expanding their musical world throughout 2026 with further performances and musical endeavors. The group’s commitment to crossover music promises a year filled with innovative and inspiring creations.
This performance solidifies La Poem’s position as a leading voice in the music scene, offering a beacon of hope as the world enters a new year.
